The '''Offworld Special Events''' was an organization charged to organize concerts and spectacles in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] era. [[Litassa Colay]] was its director.<ref name="Handoff" />

==History==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Offworld Special Events organized a concert in the [[Chibias/Legends|Chibias]] [[Chibias concert hall|concert hall]].<ref name="Handoff" />
